response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
